children: Amazon Chief Executive Andy Jassy says he hopes Nvidia remains strong through the succession drama with Jensen Huang. In an interview with CNBC, Jassy describes Amazon's relationship with Nvidia as a "co-opetition," where the companies are both partners and competitors. Jassy says there is room for both Nvidia and Amazon to be successful in the industry, and he doesn't wish ill on competitors. "I think of ourselves more as a partner to Nvidia than as a competitor, even though there's some overlap," Jassy says. "I believe Nvidia's business will be very strong for as long as I can foresee, and we will be partners with them." (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
